'''Beau Roussaeu''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 11th at [[April 2001 Frankenmuth tournament]] on 7 April 2001, according to Andrew Ehret's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2033">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-07-frankenmuth-michigan-on-4-8-2001d2033/ frankenmuth-michigan-on-4-8-2001], DeckTech (Andrew "Gwaihir" Ehret, 7 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-07-frankenmuth-michigan-on-4-8-2001d2033/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
